clips.title: Ink Pad vs Seal Stamp Battle
grammar: 対する — facing / as opposed to
〜て握られている — passive ongoing state

lines.ja: さあ、ついに対峙したこの二人！
lines.en: Now, these two finally face off against each other!
lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.ja: 青コーナー、優雅なる狙撃手・叶！
lines.en: In the blue corner, the graceful sniper, Kanae!
lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.ja: 手に持つのは……なんと巨大な『朱肉』！
lines.en: Held in his hand is... a giant red ink pad!
lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.ja: 対する赤コーナー、銀髪の吸血鬼・葛葉！
lines.en: Facing him in the red corner, the silver-haired vampire, Kuzuha!
lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.ja: その右手に握られているのは、鈍く輝く特大の『印鑑』だ！
lines.en: Clutched in his right hand is a dimly glowing, extra-large seal stamp!
lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.en: What kind of showdown is this?
lines.speaker: Kuzuha

clips.title: You Can't Prove Anything Without Ink

lines.ja: 葛葉が不敵に笑い、印鑑を剣のように構えます。
lines.en: Kuzuha grins fearlessly and readies the seal stamp like a sword.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: おいおい叶、そんな真っ赤な座布団で俺様に勝てると思ってんのか？
lines.en: Hey now, Kanae, you think you can beat me with that bright red cushion?
lines.speaker: Kuzuha

lines.ja: 叶はいつもの柔らかな微笑みを崩さず、朱肉の表面を指先でなぞります。
lines.en: Kanae keeps his usual gentle smile and traces the surface of the ink pad with his fingertip.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: ふふ、葛葉くん。印鑑だけじゃ、何も『証明』できないよ？
lines.en: Heh, Kuzuha-kun. With just a stamp, you can't 'certify' anything, can you?
lines.speaker: Kanae

lines.ja: 何も証明できないからってこと？
lines.en: you can't certify anything—is that what he means?
lines.speaker: Kuzuha

lines.ja: うざいんだけど上手くねえ？
lines.en: It's so annoying, but isn't it kind of clever?
lines.speaker: Kuzuha
